title: Show total product count above the product list
description: As a user, I want to see the total number of products displayed above the product list (e.g. 'Showing 7 products') so that I know how many products exist at a glance.
acceptance_criteria: A label appears above the product list showing the total count, e.g. 'Showing 7 products'
The count reflects the number of products currently displayed in the list
When only 1 product is shown, the label reads 'Showing 1 product' (singular)
